title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Document Extensions: Counting Convention for Mail and Phone Applicants
content:
**Convention.** When the documents due date of a Patient Financial Assistance Program case is extended, the counting convention depends on how the applicant deals with the laboratory: an application received by mail counts the adjusted days as business days from the current documents due date and then adds the mail allowance days, 3 days; an application taken by phone for an applicant who has made no portal payment in the last twelve whole months and has made a mail or phone payment in that time counts the adjusted days as business days from the current documents due date; for any other application this convention does not change the count. The adjusted days are the extension's days as they stand before they are counted.

**Business days.** Counting business days, every full five business days covers seven calendar days, the remaining business days cover as many calendar days, and two more calendar days are added when those remaining days run past a Friday. The remaining days run past a Friday when the day reached by adding them to the current documents due date falls after the Friday of that due date's own week, weeks running Monday to Sunday.

**Records read.** How the application was received is the application channel on the case. Payments are read from the household's Patient Invoices & Statements: a portal payment is one made through the online portal; a mail or phone payment is one made by mail, through the automated phone line or with a phone agent; "the last twelve whole months" takes payments dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today.

The count reached is the number of calendar days the documents due date moves forward.

## Worked counts (hypothetical adjusted days: 17)

| Application | Current documents due date | Business-day span | Calendar days the due date moves | Extended due date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Received by mail | Friday 9 October 2026 | Three full fives cover 21 days; remainder 2 runs past Friday, so 2 more: 25 | 25, plus 3: 28 | Friday 6 November 2026 |
| Taken by phone, mail-and-phone payer | Friday 9 October 2026 | 25 | 25 | Tuesday 3 November 2026 |
| Received by mail | Monday 12 October 2026 | Three full fives cover 21 days; remainder 2 reaches Wednesday: 23 | 23, plus 3: 26 | Saturday 7 November 2026 |
| Taken by phone, mail-and-phone payer | Monday 12 October 2026 | 23 | 23 | Wednesday 4 November 2026 |
